en: The image shows an old hand-tinted postcard depicting a charming historical scene with several large stone buildings, including a round tower with a distinctive blue dome and conical red roofs. There are trees and a fence in the foreground, along with a few people walking or playing. The postcard has the printed text 'Wurzen.' in the top left and 'Am Schlosse.' in the top right, suggesting a location by a castle.
